summary: The commenter argues that parents must be fully informed about any gender transition content or exposure their children receive in school, asserting that teachers should not be the sole gatekeepers of such information.

claims.requested_action: Require schools to notify parents of any gender transition content or exposure to their children
claims.argument: Parents should be fully informed about any gender transition content their children are exposed to in school to ensure their safety and well-being.
